description: This Java source file defines an abstract factory class for creating pub-sub (publish-subscribe) components utilizing Akka actors, distributed data extensions, and topic extraction. It provides methods to instantiate distributed publishers and subscribers, along with embedded static classes for configuring distributed data providers tailored to specific cluster roles and message types.

classes.name: AbstractPubSubFactory
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a factory for creating pub-sub publishers and subscribers with distributed data support using Akka actors. It manages actor creation, configuration, and provides embedded static classes for handling distributed data providers based on cluster roles and message types.

classes.name: DDataProvider
classes.description: Static nested class providing configured instances for compressed distributed data extensions, identified by cluster role.

classes.name: LiteralDDataProvider
classes.description: Static nested class providing configured instances for literal distributed data extensions, identified by cluster role and message type.

methods.name: startDistributedPub
methods.description: Creates and starts a distributed publisher actor supervisor, returning a DistributedPub instance linked to it.

methods.name: startDistributedSub
methods.description: Creates and starts a distributed subscriber actor supervisor, returning a DistributedSub instance configured with the ddata.
